measurements.note: Specimen type Printed (implied by the document): its table labels its other rows with a print orientation, "Tensile strength at break (3D printing) * 65 MPa ISO 527 (1) Elastic modulus 12500 MPa ISO 527 (1)" (p. 1). Flagged physically implausible by: 12.5 GPa is 2.5 times the next PLA-CF's printed modulus (Ecomax CarbonX CF-PLA, 4.95 GPa, V003304) and beyond what 10 % short carbon fibre in PLA reaches even moulded (about 7 GPa). Its own row, unlike its neighbours, carries no "(3D printing)" label, and Spectrum labels its rows one by one. The sheet's 65 MPa at 0.5 % (V003096, V003095) implies about 13 GPa, so the sheet agrees with itself and is probably wrong as a whole; Spectrum's word would settle it. Specimen type set back to Not published by: Spectrum labels its rows one by one ("injection moulding" on its PET-G Matt sheet's modulus row beside rows marked "(3D printing)"), so the label of another row speaks for that row only, and this row states none.

measurements.note: Corrected against the source: the number the row recorded as its test temperature is the load it was tested under, which its own Test load MPa column already holds; the sheet states no test temperature. Corrected against the source: Specimen / print parameters holds what p. 1 prints under "Printed Specimen Conditions", the conditions its test specimens were printed under (D63), which took out of the product's print profile. Corrected on the page image: the sheet prints "Deflection Temperature at 0.45 MPa (66psi)" with ISO 75 and °C in their own columns; the load had been read as the unit ("0.45 °C ISO 75"). Flagged physically implausible: the sheet prints a heat deflection of 91 °C at 0.45 MPa beside its own glass transition of 60 °C (DSC), on bars its "Printed Specimen Conditions" block prints on a 23 °C bed, and states no annealing. A glassy PLA bar deflects near its glass transition (this database's 98 PLA pairs: a median of 4 °C below it, none of the glassy ones more than 5 °C above); 31 °C above it is a crystallised (annealed or moulded) bar's, which the page does not say this was. Kept as printed; it backs nothing.
